title: Political Economy & Economic History
description: Institutions, state formation, trade, coercion, and industrial development in historical perspective.
descriptionZh: 从历史视角阅读制度、国家形成、贸易、强制与工业发展。

title: Formal Political Economy
description: Commitment, political agency, conflict, signaling, and beliefs through formal models.
descriptionZh: 通过形式模型理解承诺、政治代理、冲突、信号与信念。

title: Poetics and Comparative Literature
description: Poetry, anthologies, interpretation, and comparative reading, including Chinese literary traditions.
descriptionZh: 围绕诗歌、选本、阐释与比较阅读展开，兼及中国文学传统。

title: Methods & Mathematical Foundations
description: Probability, statistical inference, econometrics, and real analysis: concepts, results, and proof techniques.
descriptionZh: 概率、统计推断、计量经济学与实分析中的概念、结论和证明方法。
